feature_contract.goal: Complete DrawIndexedPrimitiveUP performance improvement by removing redundant index scanning across both 16-bit and 32-bit stereo paths while retaining correct full bilateral draw and safe original D3D9 fallback.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: R30 UP producer only; do not modify VB/IB, main-menu, HUD, lens, SkyGlow, FFB, DX11 or DXVK.
trace_stages: R30 checks the declared vertex window, builds the unique index mask once and feeds per-eye XYZRHW transforms.
R29 raw UP draw replays both eyes; malformed caller input declines the stereo override and retains original D3D9 fallback.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: One index walk handles both supported widths while preserving left and right eye transform and touched-list semantics.
Zero, oversized, overflowing or out-of-window index declarations reject injection to original D3D9; positive and negative differential tests remain green.
DX9Ex Active full Win32 game/host/package and Domain Isolation for the exact material SHA; no Quest3 visual/fps claim.

feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Quantified source-level index-array pass count: original R30 indexed-UP scanned indexCount twice (max-index plus sparse-mask); first material patch reduced this to one scan for D3DFMT_INDEX16 and D3DFMT_INDEX32, and this repair moves format dispatch outside the index loop. This is a deterministic CPU-work reduction, not a Quest3 FPS or p95 measurement.
subcomponents: Complete 16-bit IndexedPrimitiveUP index validation and sparse unique-vertex collection, with a single type dispatch per call
Complete 32-bit IndexedPrimitiveUP index validation and sparse unique-vertex collection, with a single type dispatch per call
Both-eye stereo transform and original D3D9 fallback for out-of-window indices and failed mask allocations

diagnosis.root_cause: R30 UP index path loops through the same 16/32-bit index data twice: max-index scan and sparse-mask construction, despite a caller-declared valid D3D9 index window.
source_trace: R30 per-eye transforms and R29 raw left/right draw
diagnosis.fix_evidence: The previous material patch removed the max-index walk and bounds checked the single mask pass. This repair hoists the 16/32-bit decoder dispatch out of the loop while retaining append-before-bit-set allocation safety and original D3D9 fallback.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Existing 2000 randomized 16/32-bit windows and negative mutations; repair replaces tautological set comparison with independent touched-list reconstruction and adds two typed-dispatch destructive mutations.
diagnosis.protected_behaviors: Stereo both eyes, legal D3D9 min/count, desktop fallback, world/HUD, SkyGlow, FFB.
diagnosis.measurement_limitation: Source-level index walk reduction is quantified; actual Quest3/VDXR 72Hz and p95/p99 frame-time improvement is NOT measured.
diagnosis.original_evidence: Previous indexed-UP producer performed one max-index pass followed by a distinct used-mask pass for the same 16/32-bit index buffer.
alternatives_rejected: Per-eye stereo vertex writes cannot be skipped without breaking the distinct Quest3 left/right views; the redundant work is confined to index decoding.
16-bit and 32-bit buffers require distinct typed reads, but do not require repeating their index-format decision for every index.

ci_evidence.failure_reason: record feature_class not MEASURED_PERFORMANCE; special_work_evidence and subcomponents missing
ci_evidence.next: New material result commit with source/test and contract repair must pass exact-SHA DX9Ex Active and Domain Isolation.
